description: An abstract base class for implementing Hono API clients that manages AMQP connection links, tracing, and message properties.

classes.name: AbstractHonoClient
classes.description: Provides common functionality for Hono API clients, including link management and tracing support.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Marks an OpenTracing span as errored and logs an exception; does not finish the span.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new child span for tracing with the 'child_of' reference.

methods.name: newFollowingSpan
methods.description: Creates a new span with a 'follows_from' reference for tracing.

methods.name: supportsCapability
methods.description: Checks if the client supports a specific AMQP capability.

methods.name: closeLinks
methods.description: Closes the sender and receiver links to the Hono server, freeing resources.

methods.name: setApplicationProperties
methods.description: Sets application properties on an AMQP message, checking for disallowed types.
